big_case.notes: Pro se paid petition asking the Court to review a Ninth Circuit memorandum affirmance applying California's litigation privilege (Cal. Civ. Code 47(b)) to privacy claims in a private dispute; state-law, fact-bound, no split; denied without response from most respondents and no noted dissent. Celebrity petitioner draws passing attention but no doctrinal stakes.
